name: pool-maintenance
//: The pool maintenance onevcs runs in idle warm-pool slots (onevcs.toml -> the justfile's `pool-maintenance` recipe) and its pass-time budget. `budgets-host` builds the workspace twice, so no per-change tier selects it: `check` never names that target, and CI runs it only on the release PR, after the full sweep (`just pool-maintenance-budget`). `lint` and `test` cover measure.sh on every change that reaches it. The budget check runs the onebudgetspec CLI the github-workflows project's private tooling lock pins.

options.command: npm ci --prefix .github/tooling --ignore-scripts && node .github/tooling/node_modules/@onebudgetspec/cli/bin/onebudgetspec.js check pool-maintenance/budgets.yaml --label host
